fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-5a166b01 at e6319c2b (attempt 2). Read the diff: ship-change.toml now has a rhiza ship gate step before every pushing step (local-gate->open-pr, gate-rebase->rebase, gate-land->land, gate-rebase-merge->rebase-merge, and merge on.fail now goes to gate-rebase-merge), each on.fail to gate-fix; ship rebase also gates the rebased head before its forced push and puts the branch back on failure; .rhiza/settings.json commits rhiza.ship.localGate = make check. Ran in a clean env (env -i; this session's RHIZA_* vars made the testscripts' rhiza init resolve the enclosing repo, at the parent commit too): go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestShipLocalGate PASS (unstable runs in the worktree, stable skips, no gate skips, failing gate fails with output, plus TestShipLocalGateOncePerHead, TestShipLocalGateSettingsFile); go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow PASS (TestShipChangeLocalGate checks every way into each push step goes through its gate); go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(ship-local-gate|run-ship-change|run-ship-change-rebase|run-ship-ci-fix|describe-golden)$' ok. Full ./internal/api -v: 0 failing tests; the package's root-state guard flagged only ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json, which the live root daemon rewrites on its own (seen changing outside any test). A binary built from e6319c2b, run in this checkout, prints rhiza daemon settings --json {key: rhiza.ship.localGate, value: make check, source: .rhiza/settings.json, scope: project}; git config has no such key. Both attempt-1 findings are fixed.
